attempts.sql: WITH requested_kinds AS (SELECT 'class' AS kind UNION ALL SELECT 'function' UNION ALL SELECT 'method'), public_counts AS (SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/tests/%' AND is_public = TRUE AND ((kind = 'class' AND qualname = name) OR (kind = 'function' AND qualname = name) OR kind = 'method') GROUP BY kind) SELECT rk.kind AS kind, CAST(COALESCE(pc.cnt, 0) AS INTEGER) AS public_count FROM requested_kinds AS rk LEFT JOIN public_counts AS pc ON rk.kind = pc.kind ORDER BY CASE rk.kind WHEN 'class' THEN 1 WHEN 'function' THEN 2 WHEN 'method' THEN 3 END;

request:
How many public classes, public module-level functions and public methods are defined in the non-test code of the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package (files under its tests/ folder excluded)? A name is public when it does not start with an underscore, so dunder methods such as __init__ are not public, and methods of a class whose name starts with an underscore are not public either. Nested functions and nested classes are not counted. Return one row per kind, with kind being 'class', 'function' or 'method'.

Requested output columns: kind (string), public_count (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: thought: I count public symbols in the symbol catalog that belong to files under the auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/ package. I exclude its root tests/ folder, use the public flag to enforce the underscore and enclosing-class rules, and require an undotted qualified name for classes and functions so nested classes and nested functions are not counted. I output all three requested kinds, using a zero count when a kind has no matching symbols; no ranking or tie-breaking applies.
sql: WITH requested_kinds AS (SELECT 'class' AS kind UNION ALL SELECT 'function' UNION ALL SELECT 'method'), public_counts AS (SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/%' AND file_id NOT LIKE 'auto_ontology/retrieval/kumo/tests/%' AND is_public = TRUE AND ((kind = 'class' AND qualname = name) OR (kind = 'function' AND qualname = name) OR kind = 'method') GROUP BY kind) SELECT rk.kind AS kind, CAST(COALESCE(pc.cnt, 0) AS INTEGER) AS public_count FROM requested_kinds AS rk LEFT JOIN public_counts AS pc ON rk.kind = pc.kind ORDER BY CASE rk.kind WHEN 'class' THEN 1 WHEN 'function' THEN 2 WHEN 'method' THEN 3 END;
